FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 259
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/29/2025
House Bill 259 as introduced could reduce potential income tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by a maximum of $2 million annually, for Fiscal Years 2027 through Fiscal Year 2031 by
establishing income tax credits ranging from $5,000 to $30,000 that may be claimed by certain
workers that relocate to certain counties. This bill provides that these credits: 1) are not
refundable or transferable; 2) are available for up to three years; 3) may be carried forward for
up to five years; and 4) are available for tax years 2026 through 2030.
